title: Register Modulation: Shifting between Formal (Ön) and Informal (Te)

sections.title: Navigating Social Politeness
sections.content: Mastering Hungarian requires fluid register management: shifting naturally between formal 3rd-person address (*Ön / Maga* with formal verb agreements) in administrative and business environments, and informal 2nd-person address (*te / ti*) among friends and colleagues.

items.spanish: Kérem, foglaljon helyet! vs Ülj le bátran!
items.english: Please, take a seat! (Formal) vs Sit down comfortably! (Informal)

items.spanish: Hogy tetszik lenni? vs Hogy vagy?
items.english: How are you doing? (Polite respectful) vs How are you? (Informal)
We can address each other informally, if you don't mind.
